measure_name: Disaster risk management linked to digital assets
definition: The project uses digital systems, data or infrastructure to prepare for, warn of, respond to or recover from disasters and climate shocks (early warning and alerting, hazard monitoring and forecasting, emergency communications and restoring connectivity after a disaster, disaster risk data and information platforms, registries, ID or digital payments used to reach people after a shock), or protects the digital assets it finances against disasters (disaster and climate risk assessment of sites, disaster recovery and backup sites, business continuity, hardening, burying or relocating infrastructure, network redundancy for continuity). A contingent emergency response component on its own, or a general statement about climate change, does not count.
note: Draft by Claude for a trial run; to be approved or revised by a person.
